slides.texte_overlay:
Things that instantly make
a man look more mature
Answering calls instead of only texting. Picking up the phone for important things, from the doctor to a friend's bad news, shows you can handle real conversations.
Owning a calendar and using it. Birthdays, appointments, bills, all written down. A man who never forgets important dates looks reliable and grown up instantly.
Cooking for others, not just for himself. Inviting friends for a real home-cooked dinner shows care, independence and a life that's really put together.
Apologising without excuses. "I was wrong, I'm sorry." No "but", no blaming. Owning mistakes cleanly is one of the clearest marks of real maturity in a man.
Staying curious as he grows up. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and having real knowledge to share makes conversations feel much more adult.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Real knowledge to share makes my conversations feel much more adult.

slides.texte_overlay: Choosing calm over winning arguments. Letting small things go and saving his energy for what matters shows he's done proving himself to everyone around him.
Taking care of his health without being told. Dentist, check-ups, sleep, real food. Looking after your body before something breaks is a quietly mature habit.
